identity.rule: Every non-empty asset reference must be an exact assetId present in the matching catalogRevision.

decisionOrder: Legal for the exact destination field
human-reviewed when choices are otherwise equal

mapping.Actor: cast[].visualAssetId; actorActions refer to the cast identity by actorId
mapping.Layer: background/layer assets in sequence.layers or shot.layerActions
mapping.Ui: dialogue portraits, bodies, frames, bubbles, overlays and dedicated UI fields
mapping.Kit: selectedKits only, using an exact usable kit contract

catalogPlacementContract.ambiguityRule: When cutsceneNeedsHumanReview is true, the asset is explicit-user-choice only for new authoring. Do not choose it automatically. If the user explicitly pinned it, use cutscenePrimaryUse for Preview and let Unity show the yellow note.
catalogPlacementContract.automaticCandidateRule: For NEW/REVISE/REPAIR requests, prefer request.suggestedCandidates for automatic asset choices. These IDs are filtered by Unity for explicit Cutscene use, Preview safety, no human-review requirement, exact resolver success, canonical Actor identity and same-identity portrait compatibility. Assets outside that shortlist require explicit user selection or stronger CURRENT Catalog evidence.
catalogPlacementContract.exampleConflictRule: The placement contract wins over every generated example. Never copy an example pattern that violates it.

castIdentityRule: The exact record must also make visual sense for the authored identity. Ship-, character-, robot- and prop-specific identities should carry their corresponding semantic capability in addition to the role requirement.
backgroundRule: A location or visual background belongs in sequence.layers. Use Cutscene.Background and negative sortingOrder; do not place a Cutscene.Background-only record in cast.
layers: assetId and replacementAssetId must resolve to exact Cutscene-safe visual records. Background and FarBackground sortingOrder must be negative.
animations: Every animationAssetId must resolve to Cutscene.Animation and appear in the actor record's exported compatibleAnimationIds list. Never infer compatibility from filename, folder, naming, or visual similarity. When verified compatible animation options are supplied, prefer the exact matching Run, Walk, Hit or Idle animation requested by the story.

dialogueBubbles.selection: Choose the best explicitly-described Preview-safe tail/side variant for composition only when a bubble is required.
dialogueBubbles.normalFallback: Allow the canonical Dialogue Stage frame when the preset needs no specific bubble.

effects.rule: SpeedLines, Vignette, ScreenFlash, ColorFlash, Silhouette and Overlay use the canonical procedural built-in route and omit assetId. Every other effect requires an exact Effect-primary Preview-safe Catalog assetId. All effects remain visualOnly=true.

audio: audio[].assetId must resolve to an exact audio record when non-empty.
kits: Use only a kit contract with usable=true from CUTSCENE_KIT_CONTRACTS_V5.json. Copy its exact kitId, anchorId and cameraId values. Author a stable unique kitUseId for the package instance.
fallback: When the exact requested record does not exist, choose the closest legal explicitly-described Preview-safe alternative. If none exists, omit an optional element where possible and add missingAssets only when required. Never invent an ID or silently change the core story.
